import json

trace = [
    {
        'step': 1,
        'file': 'src/tag.c',
        'function': 'tag_parse',
        'line': 142,
        'var': 'search',
        'code': 'search = strstr(buffer, \"\\n\\n\");',
        'note': 'strstr searches for \\n\\n without respecting buffer_end, causing an out-of-bounds read past the buffer'
    },
    {
        'step': 2,
        'file': 'src/tag.c',
        'function': 'tag_parse',
        'line': 144,
        'var': 'buffer',
        'code': 'buffer = search + 1;',
        'note': 'If strstr returns a pointer past buffer_end, buffer now points outside the valid range'
    },
    {
        'step': 3,
        'file': 'src/tag.c',
        'function': 'tag_parse',
        'line': 149,
        'var': 'text_len',
        'code': 'text_len = buffer_end - ++buffer;',
        'note': 'Subtracting pointers when buffer > buffer_end causes size_t underflow, producing a huge text_len'
    },
    {
        'step': 4,
        'file': 'src/tag.c',
        'function': 'tag_parse',
        'line': 152,
        'var': 'tag->message',
        'code': 'tag->message = git__malloc(alloc_len);',
        'note': 'The huge text_len leads to an oversized allocation, potentially causing a crash or invalid memory access'
    }
]

with open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(trace, f, indent=2)
print('Trace written')
"
